intro: Combine critical reading, source synthesis, caution and defence of a recommendation.

frases.estudio: Rapport A registrerte 31 prosent færre avbrudd etter at stillerom ble innført på én avdeling. Målingen varte i seks uker. Rapport B fant høyere tilfredshet blant ansatte som brukte fleksible plasser, men bare 42 av 110 svarte på spørreundersøkelsen. Begge rapportene anbefaler en ny evaluering etter et halvt år.
frases.alumno: Report A recorded 31% fewer interruptions after quiet rooms were introduced in one department. The measurement lasted six weeks. Report B found greater satisfaction among employees who used flexible desks, but only 42 of 110 responded. Both reports recommend a further evaluation after six months.

texto: The reports measure different outcomes and have different limits. Don't combine their percentages as if they proved a single cause. A balanced recommendation can propose a limited trial, agreed criteria and a later review.

pregunta.texto: What is the main difference between the results?

opciones.texto: A measures interruptions and B measures satisfaction
Both measure the same variable with an equal sample
opciones.explicacion: One records interruptions and the other satisfaction; the samples also differ.

opciones.texto: A measures costs and B measures duration
opciones.explicacion: Neither of those is the outcome described.

pregunta.texto: Synthesise both reports, point out a limitation and defend a recommendation with an evaluation criterion.

textos: Rapport A fant færre avbrudd, mens rapport B registrerte tilfredshet blant respondentene. Svarprosenten i B var lav, og resultatene måler ulike ting. Vi bør teste begge tiltak i én avdeling og måle avbrudd og tilfredshet etter seks måneder.

piezas.explicacion: Model: keeps the results separate, acknowledges a limitation and proposes a measurable evaluation.
